faqs.question: Is there a free trial?
faqs.answer: Yes! We offer a 14-day free trial with full Pro features. No credit card required.

faqs.question: Can I change plans anytime?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. Upgrade or downgrade anytime. Changes take effect immediately with prorated billing.

faqs.question: What happens if I exceed my call limit?
faqs.answer: We'll notify you at 80% usage. You can purchase additional calls or upgrade your plan.

faqs.question: Do you offer annual billing?
faqs.answer: Yes! Save 20% with annual billing. Contact sales for custom enterprise pricing.
